evals.name: refresh-both-repositories
evals.prompt: Refresh the standards matrix for .github and webc-docs and update the published page.
evals.expected_output: Checks out each repository's default branch & every open pull request head into new scratchpad folders, gathers pull request & CI state with the GitHub tools into prs.json, runs scripts/scan.js with --previous set to the published page, asks about each manual row that is older than 14 days, builds the page with scripts/build.js, reads the published artifact before republishing it with its url, & reports counts per repository, the rows that changed, & what the scan could not see.
expectations: Runs scripts/scan.js on checkouts instead of copying statuses from the previous page
Marks a row as in an open pull request only when the pull request head passes the check
Asks the maintainer about the manual rows instead of keeping their old statuses
Reads the artifact before publishing & republishes with its url so the link is kept
Does not push, comment on, or edit either repository
Reports the rows whose status changed since the last scan
Adds no AI attribution footer to anything it posts or publishes

evals.name: branch-protection-question
evals.prompt: Are both Node jobs required checks in branch protection on webc-docs? Put the answer in the matrix.
evals.expected_output: States that branch protection is a GitHub setting no file or scan shows, asks the maintainer instead of inferring it from the workflow file, & records the answer with today's date as the row's verified date in the manual rows.
expectations: Does not infer required checks from ci.yml
Asks the maintainer for the setting
Records the answer with a verified date in the manual rows
